summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Chicago Rivet & Machine Co. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (Item 5.07) and announcing the Board's approval of a temporary suspension of its quarterly cash dividend (Item 8.01). The shareholder vote elected seven director nominees and ratified the independent auditor; no dissident or contested items were disclosed. The dividend suspension is described as a proactive capital-allocation move to fund operational and growth initiatives, not a special-situation event. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or liquidation is involved. The filing is a standard current report on routine corporate governance and a capital-allocation change, which does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
